newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins steady, waiting for Fed rate news.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins steady, waiting for Fed rate news.

text.p: The Russian MinFin market is waiting to see if the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates and was quiet on Monday, traders said, adding the market had already largely priced in a 25 basis-point hike in U.S. rates.
The U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meets on Tuesday to discuss interest rates. Dealers said the market was sure to liven up once a decision was made public.
Mosbiznesbank dealer Igor Potapov said: "People have been cautious in the last ten days. We see constant fluctuations but they are not really affecting price levels."

"The day is calm as the market is waiting for the rate change," Moscow Business World Bank dealer Sergei Kovzharov said and added some brief buying had been seen in early trading before London opened.
